messages.author: 6cb7e6ca1020360a
messages.subject: distance problem
parts:
Hi all,
I have been designing a sea survey,
type of design: line, equal angle zig zag.
I can create the survey, but I can't calculate the coverage probability. It
gets stuck. It is no a computer problem because I tryed with different ones,
and quite porwerful.
Have you ever had the same problem? A bug? Or I might do something
wrong....but I can't find what.

thank you
Antonella
